counters.intel: Requisition logs mention "a great deal of netting." They know your things fly.
counters.news: Police quartermaster orders 400m of netting. No reason given. Locals nervous.

counters.intel: Somebody has been reading about conductivity. Expect prods.
counters.news: Precinct buys every cattle prod in the county. "Unrelated to the fish thing," says spokesperson.

counters.intel: They have stopped trying to punch through the plating and started shouting at it.
counters.news: Captain Clampdown requisitions a louder megaphone. Armour plating reportedly "unbothered, for now."

counters.intel: They are sending things that do not breathe. Rude, but effective.
counters.news: Motor pool doubles its order. "Engines don't inhale," reads the internal memo we absolutely did not steal.

counters.intel: Air support. Because everything you field insists on standing on the ground.
counters.news: County leases a helicopter. The invoice line reads "anti-goat measures."

counters.intel: Water cannons. Somebody worked out that a soaked flyer is a falling flyer.
counters.news: Harbour patrol reassigned inland. Nobody will explain the water cannons.

counters.intel: Boots. Lots of boots. They intend to fight this one on dry land.
counters.news: National Guard issues waders and a strongly worded pamphlet about ponds.
